results.overview: A vampire hunter fights to save a besieged city from an army of otherworldly beasts controlled by Dracula himself.
results.name: Castlevania

results.overview: As revolution sweeps France, Richter Belmont fights to uphold his family's legacy and prevent the rise of a ruthless, power-hungry vampire ruler.
results.name: Castlevania: Nocturne

results.overview: An interpretation of a possible backstory for Simon Belmont, the protagonist of the Castlevania video games. It should come as a relief to old-school gamers that the serialized story seems to focus more on references and lore from the three NES games, rather than anything from the more recent (and terrible) games.
results.name: Castlevania: Hymn of Blood
